surface_mechanism: The basmala frames the oath, the night-to-dawn movement, divine action, creation, and the judgment of past power under divine lordship and mercy.
89:1-5 forms a temporal and numerical oath sequence: dawn, ten nights, paired and unpaired number, the passing night, and an oath addressed to restraining intellect.
89:6-8 turns from cosmic signs to historical seeing: the Lord's action against ancient Aad, Iram of the pillars, and an unmatched created form among the lands.

The strongest secondary network therefore joins time and recurrence, number and division, cognition and testimony, divine agency, ancient tribal memory, monumental architecture, creation and comparison, and bounded lands.
